gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (pp4-5) prints columns General, Street, Keno, LB840 Economic Development, LB840 Infrastructure, Total; statement total 1,555,647 + nonoperating 80,324 (rows add to 1,635,969). detail has only the General Fund departments (pp11-12): 985,395 + sale of assets 19,113 + interest 55,221 = 1,059,729, equal to the General column. The other four columns have no schedule of their own (the all-funds budget p10 prints only combined revenues). Missing: Street 1,517 + 34,067 + 205,293 + 3,459 + 28,708 + 300 = 273,344 (printed 273,345); Keno 21,371 + interest 5,990 (p5) = 27,361; LB840 Economic Development sales tax 88,533; LB840 Infrastructure sales tax 187,002. Sum 576,240 = gap. Check: 1,059,729 + 576,240 = 1,635,969.

gaps.explanation: Statement p5 Total expenditures paid 1,340,980 (Total-column rows add to 1,340,978). detail: General Fund departments 1,138,851 (pp11-12; the department columns add 6 more than the printed General total 1,138,845, report rounding), budget p10 Streets 170,156 (= Street column total), Keno 4,349 (= Keno column), 'Economic Development' 225 (= LB840 Infrastructure column, professional fees 225) = 1,313,581. The LB840 Economic Development column (p4) spent 27,404 and is in no schedule: Personnel 2,478, Contract services 22,393, Office 990, Professional fees 458, Taxes 2, Supplies 83, Miscellaneous 1,000. After adding: 1,313,581 + 27,404 = 1,340,985 vs statement 1,340,978. The remaining 7 is the report's own rounding only: General Fund department lines +6 over the printed General column total, printed column totals (1,138,845 + 170,156 + 4,349 + 27,404 + 225 = 1,340,979) vs Total-column rows 1,340,978 (Repairs 58,102 + 57,414 printed 115,515; Supplies printed 65,192 for 65,193). No amount is missing beyond the 27,404.

gaps.explanation: Statement p7: total operating expenses 542,165 + interest and fees expense 26,916 (rows add to 569,080). detail has only the all-funds budgetary-basis schedule (p10) function lines Water 226,783, Wastewater 83,529, Sanitation 180,023 = 490,335 (cash/budgetary basis: no depreciation, includes other cash outlays). These are the same funds' spending as the p7 Water / Sewer / Sanitation columns, so once the statement column lines are added (needed for the revenue gap and the per-fund detail rule) the three budget lines would count the same money twice: remove detail[98], [99], [100] and add the p7 column rows. Water 29,618 + 3,622 + 2,330 + 29,794 + 8,115 + 40,805 + 817 + 17,191 + 126,442 = 258,734 + interest 11,688; Sewer 20,297 + 2,100 + 8,115 + 4,981 + 4,515 + 2,487 + 57,617 = 100,112 + interest 15,228; Sanitation 7,944 + 166,540 + 8,115 + 597 + 122 = 183,318. Added 569,080. Check: 490,335 - 490,335 + 569,080 = 569,080 = statement.
